mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchants (brand_id, category_id, merchant_code, merchant_name, address, latitude, longitude, phone) VALUES (#{brandId}, #{categoryId}, #{merchantCode}, #{merchantName}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{phone})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM merchants ORDER BY merchant_id DESC
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM merchants WHERE merchant_code = #{merchantCode})
mapper.update: UPDATE merchants SET brand_id = #{brandId}, category_id = #{categoryId}, merchant_code = #{merchantCode}, merchant_name = #{merchantName}, address = #{address}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, phone = #{phone} WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}
